complete_examples.text: Besides, the failure probability of the bridge is very small attribution to the higher allowable threshold (e.g., mid-span displacement), but the safety of train operation decreases with the increase of vehicle speed especially under the critical speed of resonance.

The above literature focused on the stochastic analysis of the train–bridge dynamic systems subjected to uncertainty parameters and excitations, but these did not fully describe the time-varying process of dynamic reliability subject to a moving train and time-dependent exci tation, since the failure probability of a system is a cumulative process in principle, namely, not allowed to jump from failure domain to safety domain in a train operation, however, the cumulative process of time-varying dynamic reliability is not reflected in Ref. [18,19] by PDEM.
